title: Coral and the Gravity Revisited
author: Rosalind Delacroix
blurb: Marguerite Quintana, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
